title: Quotient specialization and scalar comparison equation
statement: For the canonical strict coefficient exchange arrows [def-sbc-strict-coefficient-exchange-arrows], using quotient coefficient presentations [def-sbc-quotient-coefficient-presentation], a quotient presentation at a corner and level is a locally surjective map of ring sheaves $O_W\to A_W$ together with an isomorphism from $Q_{W,n}$ to the restriction of $A_W[0]$. Use exact derived scalar restriction on the same underlying site. For a square of these quotient ringed sites, a scalar comparison consists of four inverse-image and two direct-image natural isomorphisms, commuting with the two adjunction counits and with the inverse-image square. Define the quotient exchange equation to say that, for every such quotient presentation and square, every compatible scalar comparison, every quotient-module derived input $J$, and every identification of its restricted input with the evaluated $\mathcal R_TK$, the scalar restriction of the quotient square mate equals evaluation of $v$, under the source and target comparisons and that same input identification.
